name: Backup freshness
desc: Checks that the backup folders you list got new files recently. Report only.
prompt: For each selected host, check each watched path with files.newest_mtime and report the newest file time per path (each output line starts with a Unix time). A path with nothing in the last 2 days is stale: say so clearly. If a host has no watched paths, say they can be added under Agent policy.
